_comment: Every run declares a tracePath and not one of them exists -- the shape of a run whose --keep-temp workspaces were cleaned up before the gate ran. The session check has nothing to read, so it can say nothing about MCP connectivity. It used to `continue` past each missing file and report a clean structural pass on zero evidence (the same silent-disable the real-Senzing job hit when it 'collected 0 traces on two consecutive runs'). Both gates are otherwise green here, so rc 2 can only come from the trace check.
